title: The New Frontier
description:
S05 E05 — Increasing Orbit
The ISS is the workhorse of the international space faring community, faces its end, sparking plans for replacement stations.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S05 E06 — Mountains in the Dark
Asteroids, remnants of the early solar system, offer insights into planetary origins; Psyche spacecraft prepares to analyze a distinctive metallic asteroid.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S05 E07 — Oceans in the Sky
Juice and Europa Clipper missions target Jupiter, dedicating four years to studying its atmosphere, magnetosphere and icy moons like Europa, Callisto and Ganymede.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S05 E08 — Webb of Life
The James Webb Space Telescope is active after launch via Ariane 5; this $10 billion spacecraft orbits the Sun, poised to explore distant galaxies, analyze exoplanet atmospheres and spark fresh inquiries in the quest for knowledge.

title: How Things Work
description:
S01 E07 — Skateboards, Vacuum Cleaners and ATMs
Skateboard, vacuum cleaner, ATM, car jack, digital projector and multi-tool; using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

title: The Flying Kestrel
description:
S01 E04 — Record Day
The transformation is complete, and it's time for the Flying Kestrel to be put to the test.

title: The Flying Kestrel
description:
S01 E05 — Record Day
The owner of Kestrel Beer buys an original 1930s Riley Kestrel, with the intention of restoring it and then breaking the land-speed record.

title: The Flying Kestrel
description:
S01 E08 — The Crash
After driver Jon Webster crashes the Flying Kestrel at 148 mph, the team must work out what went wrong and decide if the dream of a land speed record is worth risking it all.

title: Secrets of the Brain
description:
S02 E08 — Empathy
Meeting an individual who has an extraordinary neurological condition, mirror touch synesthesia, allows them to feel the exact sensation or emotion of another.

title: Secrets of the Brain
description:
S02 E09 — Gut
Jack meets a poker player who has won millions in high stakes international tournaments using his gut instincts.

title: Secrets of the Brain
description:
S02 E10 — Twins
Dr Jack Lewis is on a mission to understand why identical twins are such an asset to science from development in the womb onwards.

title: Xploration Earth 2050
description:
S01 E04 — The Cyborgs Are Coming
A search-and-rescue robot doubles as a tank; a therapy robot looks and acts like a real pet; a high-tech firemen's mask has more than X-ray vision.

title: Xploration Earth 2050
description:
S01 E05 — The Future Of Crime-Fighting
A robotic security guard; a softball-sized set of eyes and ears allow crime fighters to see danger long before it can hurt them; scanning brain waves to see if people are telling the truth.

title: Xploration Earth 2050
description:
S01 E06 — The Future Of Medicine
Electronic skin keeps tabs on vital functions and warns of trouble; implanted devices powered by the body; a simulator shows how robotic surgery will soon save lives.

title: Angry Planet
description:
S01 E04 — Fire and Water
Wildfires burn across the Yukon and George heads north along the route taken to the Klondike Gold Rush.

title: Angry Planet
description:
S01 E05 — The Winds of Autumn
It's autumn and the North Atlantic sees hurricanes while a forest fire burns in Northern Ontario.

title: Angry Planet
description:
S01 E06 — Wild Weather of 2005
George Kourounis visits Tornado Alley, descends into the Erta Ale volcano and witnesses the force of Hurricane Katrina.

title: Top 10 The Art of Architecture
description:
Museums and Galleries
Man has imagination, he can dream up and design structures, spaces and buildings. This TV show takes everyone on a journey around the world to visit architectural pieces.

title: Top 10 The Art of Architecture
description: A fresh perspective on some of the unique and beautiful buildings, structures and bridges from around the world.

title: Science of Sound
description:
S01 E06 — Developing Our Taste in Music
In the era of music streaming, there are millions of songs at our fingertips; but in a world of near infinite music choices, music discovery and exposure have changed drastically.

title: Extraordinary Humans
description:
S02 E08 — Tom Sietas
Freediver Tom Sietas holds his breath submerged for a death-defying 22 minutes.

title: Bright Now!
description:
S01 E49 — Wolves and Tanks
Nearly a century after disappearing from its natural habitat, the German wolf makes a comeback that might be attributable to an unlikely ally: the military.

title: Bright Now!
description:

A glimpse at what happens at zoos and aquariums behind closed doors.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S07 E01 — UFOs: What's Really Out There?
Emily Calandrelli searches for the truth about aliens and UFO sightings by interviewing experts and visiting Roswell, N.M., the site where some believe aliens once landed.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S07 E02 — Indigenous Astronomy
Native cultures have been studying the sky for centuries, yet their teachings have been mostly overlooked; Emily Calandrelli visits a sacred indigenous "sky party" and meets the first NASA astronaut of Native American descent.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S07 E03 — Future of the Space Industry
Space tourism; the thriving business of satellites; how much activity there will soon be in low-Earth orbit.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S07 E04 — Big Impact
Space tourism is becoming a common occurrence, thanks to the efforts of Blue Origin; a look at some moments with a "big impact" in the space industry today.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S07 E05 — Favorite Moments
Emily recalls some of her favorite moments, ranging from cutting-edge science to adventures with Student Astronaut contest winners.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S07 E06 — Space Access
Space exploration helps extend the reach of the human race to beyond our planet; exploring the ways different people, companies and organizations are making spaceflight more accessible.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S07 E07 — The Search for Life
The search for life in the universe remains one of the most ambitious quests of humankind; Emily Calandrelli explores the possibility that life exists in Earth's celestial backyard.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S07 E08 — Unsolved Mysteries of the Solar System
Even though spacecraft have been sent to every planet in the solar system, many mysteries remain; host Emily Calandrelli searches for answers to celestial mysteries that stump even the brightest scientists.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E03 — Terraforming: Can We Build a Planet B?
Once humans have managed to get a handle on building structures to live on the harsh, dangerous surfaces of other celestial bodies, what is to stop them from trying to change entire planets to suit their needs?

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E04 — Carbon Costs: Is Space Exploration Even Worth It?
There are only a handful of rocket launches every year, but that could change; each rocket that gets fired off has an impact on the atmosphere; Earth may not be able to survive hundreds, or even thousands, of fuel-burning rocket launches every year.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E11 — Toxic Space Factories
Billionaires suggest that moving toxic or pollution-heavy industries to space is a potential means of protecting the planet.

description:

A look at impossible objects such as the Penrose triangle and the brain illusion pareidolia; explores the phenomenon of levitation.

title: Re:Think
description:

Explains optical illusions like forced perspective, introduces the magic of Newtonian fluids, and an in-depth look at the magic bed of nails trick.

Everybody loves a great western except Larry; Terry gets Larry to test more scenes from classic western movies.

Don't mess with organized crime. The dynamic duo tackles scenes from the Mexico cartel series Queen of the South, but take a pit stop at the restroom to test a scene from The Foreigner with Jackie Chan.

description:
S01 E01 — Living Virtually
How did the invention of photography lead us to a world where we live entirely virtually? Alie Ward points us towards a future where we might upload ourselves to the web.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E06 — Asteroid Mining: Is the Next Gold Rush in Space?
Running out of crucial resources and materials is only a matter of time; the asteroids flying through the solar system contain tons of precious metals, stones, and more; the astronomical profits from mining asteroids could all hype.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S04 E01 — Landing on Mars
NASA has been remarkably successful sending robots to Mars' surface; host Emily Calandrelli looks at the varied and ingenious methods used to land spacecraft on the red planet, starting with Pathfinder in 1997.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S04 E02 — 2011: A Year of Space Odyssey
The year 2011 was remarkable, as NASA visited several planets, asteroids and comets; host Emily Calandrelli explores the amazing journeys of spacecraft that gathered spectacular images of Mercury, Jupiter and Mars.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S04 E03 — Surviving in Deep Space
Host Emily Calandrelli looks at how surviving in deep space can become a reality; Lockheed Martin is designing a spacecraft, similar to a smaller International Space Station, in which astronauts can make a three-year trip to Mars and back.

title: The New Frontier
description:
The Ice Giants
Beyond the asteroid belt lay the ice giants; some can be seen with the naked eye, others only glimpsed once by a passing probe.

title: The New Frontier
description:

Moons of the gas giants, each is a unique and mysterious world of its own; some have oceans of water, geysers of Sulphur or atmospheres of plastic.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S01 E08 — The Sun
The Sun bathes our planet in warmth and light; it powers the machinery of nature, our weather and encourages and sustains life on land and at sea; scientists study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S01 E09 — Exo Planets
With technological advances and improved techniques scientists are discovering more and more worlds every day.

Jörg and Cheyenne are challenged to build a slingshot that will catapult a car down a racetrack; Jörg has never been challenged to make one so big.

Inside LA's SoFi Stadium, a touchdown is made possible by Chinese rare earths, plastic grass, specialized ball factories, and fizzy sodas.

Let's take a closer look at modern mobility alternatives in the city; it presents the advantages of using rental apps for cars, e-scooters and motorcycles to reduce big city traffic.

Maxum Crane replaces a grain handler at the port, but even the best laid plans go awry.
